test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In November 2022, who among the following from India was elected as a Member of International Committee for Weight and Measures (CIPM)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Venu Gopal Achanta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prof. Venu Gopal Achanta **was elected as a Member of the **International Committee for Weight and Measures **(CIPM) on **21 Nov'22**.
 
• **Prof.Gopal **was declared an **elected Member of CIPM **during the **27th General Conference on Weights and Measures **(CGPM) meeting in **Paris, France**.
 
• **Prof. Achanta **is among **18 elected members **from different countries and the **7th personality **in **Indian history elected to CIPM**.
 
• The **CIPM **is a **supreme international committee **that functions under the authority of the **General Conference on Weights and Measures **(CGPM).
 
• It is the **highest intergovernmental international organization **created as a diplomatic treaty called **Meter Convention **signed on **20th May 1875 in Paris**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **CR Rao**

 
 
• Renowned **Indian statistician and mathematician**.
 
• Born on **September 10, 1920**.
 
• Received the **Padma Vibhushan**(2001) and the **National Medal of Science**(2002).
 
 
 
• **Amartya Sen**
 
 
• Eminent **Indian economist and philosopher**.
 
• Born on **November 3, 1933**, in **Santiniketan, West Bengal, India**.
 
• **Nobel Prize **winner in **Economic Sciences **in **1998**.
 
• **Advocate **for **social justice and human rights**.
 
 
 
• **Jean Dreeze**
 
 
• Prominent **economist specializing **in development economics.
 
• Known for his work on **poverty, hunger, and social welfare in India**.
 
• Collaborated closely with **Amartya Sen**.
 
• **Vocal advocate for social welfare policies**.
